_about: Theme schema template. Copy this file to themes/<your-name>/{light,dark}/theme.json and edit. Every key is documented inline via _comment_* keys (ignored at runtime). All keys here are required unless marked optional. Colors are RGBA arrays in the 0..1 range. Sizes ending in 'sp' scale with system font density; numbers in `layout` are dp.
name: Display name shown in Settings spinner (e.g. 'Clean Light')
_comment_font: Font face must be registered via LabelBase.register in main.py. Drop your .ttf into assets/fonts/.
_comment_font_sizes: Canonical sizes (tiny..huge) + semantic aliases (section_title/field_label/metric_value). Referenced from KV via size_role: 'medium' or size_role: 'section_title'. Panel is 1024x600 native; pick a coherent scale.

font_sizes._comment_semantic: Use these in KV instead of raw t-shirt sizes — they let you tune section vs field vs metric typography per theme without hunting through KV files.

_comment_colors: Named color roles — referenced from KV via color_role: 'font_highlight'. font_* are text colors; active/inactive/warning/error are semantic; trend/weekend/weekday/bar_* are domain-specific.

colors._comment_reserved_font_action: Reserved palette slot — not currently consumed. Intended for CTA text inside primary buttons.
colors._comment_reserved_warning: Reserved palette slot — not currently consumed. Wire via color_role: 'warning' on a future widget that needs amber attention.
colors._comment_shadow: Shadow color flips based on app.theme_mode. shadow_light is used in light mode (dark shadow on bright bg); shadow_dark is used in dark mode (light halo on dark bg).
colors._comment_button_input: Flat background for ThemedButton/ThemedSpinner/ThemedTextInput. button_bg is the resting fill (always used). button_bg_active is reserved for the pressed state but ThemedButton currently relies on Kivy's default pressed rendering — the slot is kept for parity and a future ThemedButton update. input_bg is the textbox fill; in dark themes keep it dark so font_default is readable inside it.

_comment_layout: Single source of truth for spacing/sizing — exposed to KV as `app.ui_metrics['<key>']`. grid_unit = 8 dp; everything else is a multiple of it. padding_*/spacing_* are xs=4, sm=8, md=16, lg=24. widget_height_* are sm=32, md=48, lg=64. menu_* / content_padding / widget_spacing / widget_height / small_widget_height are kept for legacy main.kv menu and older screen rules.
_comment_panels: ThemedPanel rounded-rectangle background. Alpha must be tuned in concert with overlay_opacity below — panel alpha is the only barrier between bright overlay artwork and the text rendered on top of the panel. Empirically 0.95 (dark) / 0.75 (light) reads cleanly when overlay_opacity is at or near 1.0. If you drop overlay_opacity below 0.5, you can drop panel alpha too.
_comment_overlays: Per-screen decorative PNG drawn full-screen behind content. Set to '' (empty string) to disable for that screen — render still works, just without decoration.
_comment_overlay_opacity: Global multiplier for overlay PNGs. PNGs already carry their own alpha channel; this knob lets a theme dial the whole decorative layer down (0 = invisible, 1 = full art) without re-exporting graphics. Coupling rule: when raising overlay_opacity ≥ 0.7, also raise panel_bg alpha to ≥ 0.85 (dark) / ≥ 0.75 (light) or text bleeds through saturated overlay pixels.
_comment_background: App-wide background. PNG should match 1024x600. If the file doesn't exist, app renders a solid color from panel_bg fallback.
_comment_menu: Top-bar menu styling. menu_button_normal/_active are 9-patch PNGs. menu_button_size is [width, height] in dp.
_comment_button: ThemedButton background — set to '' for plain Kivy default look.
